title: Layer 2 round 3 minor, all-four-lenses convergent: refs.rs sanitize folds degenerate HOME spellings (a space, a bare slash) and garbles record-destined diagnostics — reuse the trimmed-non-empty rule

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content: Fixed in 870836ce: the sanitize home fold applies the trimmed-non-empty unset rule (shared semantics with substrate.rs's home_dir, vsdd-cli #762) plus a two-character floor before substituting — HOME as a single space or bare slash no longer rewrites spaces or separators to tildes in record-destined diagnostics. All-four-lens convergence noted for the round record.
